approx.name: consumer-blur
approx.note: Gaussian Blur, calibrated: Blurriness = 1.7464·radius, Repeat Edge Pixels on. AE blurs in linear light (γ 2.4), so it stands in for linearize on (≤ 0.033 mean, a 1-px grid's worst); linearize off, bokeh / convolve and radius > 42.7 (toolbox's 64-tap cap) → shader. · measured with the working space un-linearized — the project keeps Linearize Working Space off · radius: driven by consumer-blur:out → a live AE expression (equal to toolbox at every frame 0–59) · ADBE Gaussian Blur 2 — Blurriness = 1.7464·radius (σ_AE = B/3.50 in linear light, σ_toolbox = r/2; R² 0.999999996 over r 2–42). Matches linearize on: toolbox decodes piecewise sRGB, AE a pure 2.404 power, so fine mixed detail (a 1-px grid) sits up to 0.033 brighter in AE; noise and soft content ≤ 0.002 mean. Never in a linearized working space: Gaussian Blur 2 then linearizes twice (γ ≈ 5.4).
